# bthwani-agent-os-2026-v3-ui-kit-evolution-guard

## Purpose
Protects and improves ui-kit during UI execution.

## Procedure
1. Gather evidence first.
2. Classify the signal.
3. Refuse unsupported conclusions.
4. Produce required output fields.
5. Record next action.

## PASS Rules
- Evidence exists.
- No unsupported claim exists.
- Next human action exists.
- 100/100 only.

## FAIL/BLOCK Rules
- Missing evidence.
- 99/100.
- Vague next action.
- Random learning.
